Name: Doeg the Edomite
Summary: Doeg the Edomite, Saul's chief herdman, saw David receive bread and Goliath's sword from Ahimelech at Nob and reported it to Saul. When Saul's own servants refused to kill the priests, Doeg did it himself, slaughtering eighty-five priests and the whole city of Nob.
KeyStory: Doeg's report turned a loaf of bread into a massacre of eighty-five priests.
RelatedPeople: King Saul; King David; Ahimelech, Son of Ahitub
LifeLesson: A tale carried to a jealous king can become a sword in someone else's hand.
